originalGymProfileEvidence.author: Tom Hayes
originalGymProfileEvidence.finding: Two broad flat wooden banks; rails ascend an end, cross the top and descend the other end. Original map inset corroborates flat faces and a central door.
originalGymProfileEvidence.dimensions: Inferred from the map and native-skater clearance; not extracted original dimensions.

westPassageEvidence.finding: Prototype comparison says the side passage could be accessed from inside the gym in the early build, unlike the final game.
westPassageEvidence.reconstruction: Traced visible pavilion and glazed passage with solid boundaries and supported roofs. No invented portal or hidden cross-hall.

ditchSlapEvidence.title: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater (PS1) - School Miami All Gaps
ditchSlapEvidence.finding: Visible shallow takeoff bank beside the trench, with a bridge to the right and the classroom beyond the far landing. The original walkthrough also specifies jumping the ditch using ramps.
ditchSlapEvidence.placement: Banks placed after the third bridge; this is a layout inference from the footage and clearance, not an extracted coordinate. Run 2.2, rise 0.55 and width 5.8 are authoring units before the 2x transform.

classroomFootprintEvidence.verification: Simple editor-valid polygon; independent ray clearance along all 97 authored Long Ass Rail samples.
classroomFootprintEvidence.dimensions: Inferred from the image; original source coordinates remain unverified.
